meta.prompt: Show six running shoes as a carousel I can swipe or step through with arrows, with dots for the position: each has a picture placeholder, name, price and rating. Tapping one opens its details in place (description, sizes to pick, add to bag) with a way back to the carousel.
meta.text:
state view=0
state page=0
state size=""
Card w:390 gap:12
  if view==0
    Row middle gap:8
      IconButton "chevron_left" -> page=max(0,page-1)
      Column grow
        if page==0
          Column gap:8 pad:8 center
            Image "https://placehold.co/240x160?text=Aero+Run" w:240 h:160 radius:12
            Text.heading "Aero Run"
            Text.strong "$120"
            Row gap:4 center
              Icon "star"
              Text.muted "4.8"
            Button.outline "View details" -> view=1
        if page==1
          Column gap:8 pad:8 center
            Image "https://placehold.co/240x160?text=Trail+Blazer" w:240 h:160 radius:12
            Text.heading "Trail Blazer"
            Text.strong "$135"
            Row gap:4 center
              Icon "star"
              Text.muted "4.6"
            Button.outline "View details" -> view=2
        if page==2
          Column gap:8 pad:8 center
            Image "https://placehold.co/240x160?text=Swift+Pace" w:240 h:160 radius:12
            Text.heading "Swift Pace"
            Text.strong "$98"
            Row gap:4 center
              Icon "star"
              Text.muted "4.4"
            Button.outline "View details" -> view=3
        if page==3
          Column gap:8 pad:8 center
            Image "https://placehold.co/240x160?text=Cloud+Stride" w:240 h:160 radius:12
            Text.heading "Cloud Stride"
            Text.strong "$150"
            Row gap:4 center
              Icon "star"
              Text.muted "4.9"
            Button.outline "View details" -> view=4
        if page==4
          Column gap:8 pad:8 center
            Image "https://placehold.co/240x160?text=Road+Racer" w:240 h:160 radius:12
            Text.heading "Road Racer"
            Text.strong "$110"
            Row gap:4 center
              Icon "star"
              Text.muted "4.5"
            Button.outline "View details" -> view=5
        if page==5
          Column gap:8 pad:8 center
            Image "https://placehold.co/240x160?text=Tempo+Lite" w:240 h:160 radius:12
            Text.heading "Tempo Lite"
            Text.strong "$89"
            Row gap:4 center
              Icon "star"
              Text.muted "4.3"
            Button.outline "View details" -> view=6
      IconButton "chevron_right" -> page=min(5,page+1)
    Row center gap:8
      Icon "circle" visible:=page==0
      Icon "circle_outlined" visible:=page!=0
      Icon "circle" visible:=page==1
      Icon "circle_outlined" visible:=page!=1
      Icon "circle" visible:=page==2
      Icon "circle_outlined" visible:=page!=2
      Icon "circle" visible:=page==3
      Icon "circle_outlined" visible:=page!=3
      Icon "circle" visible:=page==4
      Icon "circle_outlined" visible:=page!=4
      Icon "circle" visible:=page==5
      Icon "circle_outlined" visible:=page!=5
  if view>0
    Button.ghost "Back to carousel" -> view=0; size=""
    Image "https://placehold.co/340x180?text=Shoe" h:180 radius:12
    if view==1
      Text.title "Aero Run - $120"
    if view==2
      Text.title "Trail Blazer - $135"
    if view==3
      Text.title "Swift Pace - $98"
    if view==4
      Text.title "Cloud Stride - $150"
    if view==5
      Text.title "Road Racer - $110"
    if view==6
      Text.title "Tempo Lite - $89"
    Text.muted "A lightweight, cushioned running shoe with a breathable upper and a responsive sole for daily miles."
    Text.strong "Select size"
    Row gap:8
      ChoiceChip "8" -> size="8"
      ChoiceChip "9" -> size="9"
      ChoiceChip "10" -> size="10"
      ChoiceChip "11" -> size="11"
    Button "Add to bag" -> emit addToBag size; toast "Added to bag"
